现在我已获得所有必要信息，下面给出完整分析。

---

## 1. 收入同比增长

**计算过程：**

| 项目 | 金额 | 出处 |
|---|---|---|
| Q4 FY26 Intelligent Cloud 收入 | $39,306 百万 | financial_statements.txt 位置 8877 / 18895 |
| Q4 FY25 Intelligent Cloud 收入 | $29,878 百万 | financial_statements.txt 位置 8877 / 18895 |

**计算公式：**
同比增长率 = (39,306 − 29,878) / 29,878 × 100
= 9,428 / 29,878 × 100
≈ **31.56%**

微软在新闻稿和电话会中均四舍五入表述为 **32%**（按美元口径），按汇率不变口径为 **31%**。

出处：press_release.txt 位置 3115："Revenue in Intelligent Cloud was $39.3 billion and increased 32% (up 31% in constant currency)"；transcript.txt 位置 24808："Revenue was $39.3 billion and grew 32% and 31% in constant currency"。

---

## 2. 管理层归因（电话会原话）

管理层在 transcript.txt 位置 24808–24848 中将增长归因于以下几点：

**① Azure 增长 43%，超出预期**
> "In Azure and other cloud services, revenue grew 43%, against a prior year that included accelerating growth. Customer demand continues to exceed available capacity. Revenue growth was ahead of expectations driven by efficiency gains across our CPU and GPU fleet as well as process improvements to enable earlier delivery of new capacity. That additional in-quarter capacity for Azure was quickly monetized."

**② GitHub Copilot 消费超预期**
> "Results also benefited from stronger-than-expected GitHub Copilot consumption following the June business model change to align pricing with usage and value."

**③ 本地服务器业务合同续约的记账时点**
> "In our on-premises server business, revenue was relatively unchanged year-over-year and was down 1% in constant currency. Results were ahead of expectations primarily driven by renewals with higher in-period revenue recognition from the mix of contracts."

**④ AI 基础设施的持续投入与 Azure 效率改善**（毛利率部分）
> "Segment gross margin dollars increased 24% … primarily driven by sales mix shift to Azure, as well as the continued scaling of our AI infrastructure ahead of growing demand, partially offset by ongoing efficiency gains in Azure."

**⑤ 共享 R&D 投资**（运营费用）
> "Operating expenses increased 10% driven by the shared R&D investments noted earlier."

---

## 3. 事实 vs. 前瞻性表述

以下逐条标注：

| 归因 | 性质 | 区分依据 |
|---|---|---|
| Azure 收入同比增长 43% | **已发生事实** | 电话会使用过去时态 "grew 43%" 描述已报告的 Q4 结果；press_release.txt 位置 3115 同样用 "increased" |
| 客户持续需求超过可用产能 | **已发生事实** | "Customer demand **continues to** exceed available capacity" 中的 "continues" 表示在 Q4 期间持续存在的状态，是已观察到的事实 |
| CPU/GPU 机队的效率提升 | **已发生事实** | "Revenue growth was ahead of expectations **driven by** efficiency gains" — 效率提升是过去已完成的动作，原文使用过去分词 "driven by" |
| 流程改进使新产能提前交付 | **已发生事实** | "process improvements to enable earlier delivery of new capacity" — 改进已经实施并在本季度内产生效果，"was quickly monetized" 为过去时 |
| 本季度额外 Azure 产能被快速变现 | **已发生事实** | "That additional in-quarter capacity for Azure **was quickly monetized**" — 明确的过去时 |
| GitHub Copilot 消费超预期 | **已发生事实** | "stronger-than-expected GitHub Copilot consumption following the June business model change" — June 的定价模型变更已落地，消费数据为 Q4 实际结果 |
| 6 月定价模型变更后按用量计费 | **已发生事实** | "the June business model change to align pricing with usage and value" — 6 月已完成的变更 |
| 本地服务器续约因合同组合产生更高的当期收入确认 | **已发生事实** | "driven by renewals with higher in-period revenue recognition from the mix of contracts" — 已报告的 Q4 结果 |
| AI 基础设施持续规模化以应对增长需求 | **含前瞻成分的混合表述** | "the continued scaling of our AI infrastructure **ahead of** growing demand" 中 "ahead of growing demand" 暗示需求将进一步增长，是对未来需求的预判；但 "continued scaling" 本身指已进行的投入 |
| Azure 持续效率改善 | **已发生事实 + 前瞻暗示** | "ongoing efficiency gains in Azure" — "ongoing" 表示持续发生，但同时也暗示未来将继续 |
| 共享 R&D 投资 | **已发生事实** | "driven by the shared R&D investments noted earlier" — 指本季度已经发生的投入 |
| **运营费用将增长 10%（展望）** | ❌ 此处不适用 | 这是已报告的 Q4 结果（past tense "increased"），不是前瞻 |

**前瞻性表述的明确出处**（不属于 Q4 归因，而是后续展望）：
- transcript.txt 位置 32535："In Azure, we expect revenue growth of approximately 45% in constant currency"
- transcript.txt 位置 32535："we continue to expect H1 growth to accelerate"

这些属于 FY27 Q1 的展望，与 Q4 已发生的归因不同。

**总结**：Q4 Intelligent Cloud 32% 增长的核心归因（Azure 43% 增长、GitHub Copilot 超预期消费、本地服务器续约记账时点）均为**已发生事实**，因为它们描述的是 Q4 已报告的业绩及其已完成的驱动因素。唯一带有前瞻色彩的是"AI 基础设施持续规模化以应对增长需求"和"Azure 持续效率改善"等表述，其中 "growing demand" 和 "ongoing" 含有对未来的预期，但其作为归因的核心支撑仍是已完成的实际投入和已实现的产能交付。
